desc.zh: 从最少删除预算出发，推导不重复的括号搜索。
desc.en: Derive duplicate-free search from the exact minimum-removal budget.

complexity: O(2^n) time in the worst case; O(n) recursion space plus output

concepts.name: Removal budget
concepts.description: Count unmatched left and right parentheses before searching.

concepts.name: Balance invariant
concepts.description: A prefix balance never becomes negative and ends at zero.
